assessment_scope: Preliminary material finding during independent full focused Design Review against approved focused-proposal-review. findings.evidence: Medium; cross-artifact; owners Release and Skill; Design stage. findings.required_outcome: Reconcile current wording with actual ownership and available evidence. Safe path: retain each prior obligation and original owner; describe current catalog as selected recurring coverage, explicitly outside prior rollout/procedure completion. Remove false claims of transferred recorded procedures/dispositions or provide accurately scoped new author-owned accounting without copying/retargeting historical approvals. Ensure Release and Skill do not turn missing scope into completed proof.

resolution.rationale: Reinspected corrected Skill and Release strategies. Skill now names the original requirement/initiative owners and explicitly excludes transfer, settlement or execution of seven scoped duties. Release now confines the focused change reference to executable refinement; future case merges are prospective. No missing historical procedure is claimed recorded and no old approval is retargeted.

findings.evidence: Medium; artifact-local; Release Design author. Compared origin/main:docs/design/engineering/release.md with relocated docs/design/engineering/release/release.md. findings.required_outcome: Preserve REL-SR-20 and REL-SR-21 under their original scoped applicability in the relocated owner, with appropriate acceptance/consumer references; keep them outside recurring Release catalog where justified. resolution.rationale: Compared current Release requirements and acceptance rows with origin/main. Exact REL-SR-20/21 normative rows and original scoped acceptance references are restored.
